description_en: Adds a log directory to an application. This operation is applicable to applications that are deployed in Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) clusters and hybrid cloud ECS clusters
description_zh: 适用于在阿里云和非阿里云ECS集群中部署的应用
name: AddLogPath

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过调用ListApplication接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the log directory that you want to add. The value must start and end with a forward slash (`/`) and must contain `/log` or `/logs`. The following directories are the default log directories in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS):

/home/admin/edas-container/logs/

/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-7.0.59/logs/

/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-production-7.0.59.3/logs/

/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-production-7.0.70/logs/

/home/admin/edas-agent/logs/
parameters.help_zh:
待收藏的应用日志的绝对路径。应用日志路径必须以`/`开头和结尾，并且路径中必须包含`/log`或者`/logs`。EDAS默认目录如下：
/home/admin/edas-container/logs/
/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-7.0.59/logs/ 
/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-production-7.0.59.3/logs/
/home/admin/taobao-tomcat-production-7.0.70/logs/
/home/admin/edas-agent/logs/
parameters.name: path

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
